evidence.field: 形義通解: 國 structure and meanings
evidence.text: The entry describes 國 as bronze-script 囗 plus phonetic 或, with 囗 representing a state's boundary or territory. It gives ‘state/country’ as the original sense and reports that Warring States forms sometimes substitute 匚 or 𠃊 as a region or boundary marker. It cites Western Zhou bronze examples and later Warring States bamboo and Han silk uses. These are source-reported usages, not a dated sequence of semantic extensions.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 國

evidence.source: CUHK Multi-function Chinese Character Database, quoting Shuowen and later commentators
evidence.field: 《說文》 explanation and early 或 usage
evidence.text: The transmitted Shuowen account says 國 means 邦 and analyzes it as 从囗从或. CUHK also reports that earlier 或 could write 國, citing He zun’s 宅茲中或; it records an alternative interpretation of 或 as 域 (‘central territory’). The He zun reading as 國 is therefore disputed in the source, not treated here as an uncontested earliest attestation.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 國

evidence.field: Western Zhou bronze-style glyph candidate, source and rights
evidence.text: The file description identifies the vector as 國 in Western Zhou bronze script style and names Xiaoxuetang, Chinese Etymology, CUHK, Chinese Text Project, and Chinese Linguipedia as source references. It specifically associates this graphic with Xiaoxuetang item 32.EC7F and 彔卣, 集成05420. It states CC0 1.0/public-domain reuse. This is a modern vector rendering, not an artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:國-bronze.svg — Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The file page links the original SVG at https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d3/%E5%9C%8B-bronze.svg. Opening the original failed with a cache-miss fetch error; the file description page itself was accessible and supplies the image identity and licensing details.

evidence.field: Reuse rights for query-interface glyph images
evidence.text: The official notice says glyph images at the resolutions obtained through its query interface and their glyph-attribute information are released under CC0 1.0. This does not grant rights to other database content or other Academia Sinica sites.
evidence.title: 小學堂字形演變 — 版權聲明

evidence.text: The 國 evolution page describes an account in which 口 denotes a region, 戈 its defense, and an enclosing 囗 is added in bronze and seal forms to represent territory. Its page footer states All Rights Reserved. It is linked as evidence only and is not proposed as an image asset. This account differs in emphasis from CUHK’s analysis of the enclosed form as 囗 plus phonetic 或.
evidence.title: 漢字「國」：字形演變

Opened the actual 國 record. It reports 囗 plus phonetic 或, boundary/territory function, Western Zhou bronze examples, later bamboo and silk examples, and a disputed interpretation of He zun.

gaps: This invocation did not independently inspect sound histories, modern readings, or Old Chinese reconstructions for 國 and 或; earlier dossier research is not re-verified here.
The source’s He zun reading of 或 as 國 is disputed, and the earliest secure attestation of the lexical item ‘country/state’ remains unsettled in the consulted material.
No complete survey was made of semantic development from boundary/territory to polity or later senses; example lists do not establish chronology.
The Academia Sinica page chardb.iis.sinica.edu.tw states All Rights Reserved, so none of its images are proposed for reuse.
The Commons image is a modern redrawn vector. Its file description identifies a source artifact reference, but this researcher did not inspect the image pixels or the artifact itself.

The direct Commons SVG retrieval failed. Xiaoxuetang’s official query-interface rights were verified, but an exact queried 国/國 glyph image and record page were not obtained, so no Xiaoxuetang asset is proposed.

items.period: Western Zhou (as labeled by the file description)
items.caption: A modern vector rendering labeled Western Zhou bronze-script 國. It illustrates the enclosing boundary element and the interior form; the file page links it to 彔卣, 集成05420.
items.alt: Modern black line rendering of an early 國 form, enclosed by a nearly rectangular outline, with a more complex angular component inside.
items.selection_reason: A directly relevant reusable example of the enclosed 國 form that the database describes as 囗 plus phonetic 或. Its stated source and date tradition make it suitable to illustrate form, with its redraw status explicit.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain, as stated on the Wikimedia Commons file page.

limitations.text: The linked direct SVG fetch failed in the web tool. The candidate is retained because its accessible Commons description page provides the identity, named source references, script label, and reuse terms; image pixels were not inspected in this research.

The Academia Sinica evolution page was used only as linked evidence because it states All Rights Reserved. The separate Xiaoxuetang CC0 notice applies to query-interface glyph images, but no exact 國 query candidate was obtained.
